# Source: https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/software/junos/identity-aware-firewall/topics/topic-map/config-examples-srx-firewall-users.html
# Page title: Configure Authentication Methods for SRX Firewall Users | Junos OS | Juniper Networks
# Source type: documentation
# Documentation set (page metadata): junos current
# Junos release shown: not stated
# Retrieved: 2026-10-13
# Assumptions: PERMIT-OPT-2 (then permit firewall-authentication, hierarchical format)
# Note: Pass-through authentication example, Results: 'show security policies' with a prompt line and a '...' elision, as published.
# Note: Text copied verbatim from the page <pre> block (line endings normalized, trailing spaces kept).
# ---
user@host# show security policies
...
from-zone UT-ZONE to-zone T-ZONE {
    policy P1 {
        match {
            source-address any;
            destination-address any;
            application junos-telnet;
        }
        then {
            permit {
                firewall-authentication {
                    pass-through {
                        client-match FWClient1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
